race.comment: LAVA FLOW (8) has started favourite at his two runs to date, at Canterbury and Hawkesbury, and been disappointing. Faces a massive drop in class today. Clearly has more to offer and this looks a nice way for the Bjorn Baker-trained gelding to build his confidence. STROLLIN' BY (12) has been handy on the corner then battled on fairly but found the class beyond her in two appearances this prep, both over 1200m at Canterbury. A slightly shorter trip against a weaker field makes her an appealing proposition. COOL ART (10) found the line well and was only beaten two lengths when resuming over 1000m at Muswellbrook recently. Nicely drawn and will appreciate the extra 200m today. Debutant I'LL BE BACK (11) best of the rest.
